title: Migrate H2 runtime onto Burrito Fleet contracts
description: Cross-repository V8 owner for replacing H2-owned session, daemon, messaging, attach, and search runtime with Burrito Fleet public clients and generic profile/plugin seams. Canonical architecture: Burrito docs/fleet-plan.md §H2 relationship and V8; executable contract: Burrito docs/fleet-test-harness.md §H2 cross-repository parity. Completion requires recorded Burrito and H2 SHAs, both repositories' CI gates, feature-matrix parity, and deletion of superseded H2 runtime code.
